Thanks for letting us know.  A bunch of us are at JSM this week but we'll try to sort this out soon.

Are you able to install by install.packages("nimble", repos = "http://r-nimble.org", type = "source")?  Do you definitely have Rtools.exe installed?

Perry

Chris
